atelier.title: A small atelier in Mississauga, founded on one belief
atelier.body1: The right gift never depends on price. It depends on the moment, and on someone taking the time to get the tone right.
atelier.body2: Velvéa was founded in 2026 to do exactly that: compose baskets by hand, only ever with products we would give ourselves, and deliver them so they arrive exactly as they looked online.

items.a: Across Ontario. We deliver ourselves throughout Mississauga and the GTA, including same-day on eligible orders, and ship with tracking anywhere else in the province. Pickup from our Mississauga studio is free, by appointment.

Always. Add your message on the product page or at checkout and we print it on a Velvéa card, tucked inside the basket, at no charge. For a small flat fee you can upgrade to a full-size store greeting card for the occasion. Prices are never included with the gift.

items.q: Are baskets pre-made or packed to order?
items.a: Every basket is assembled after you order, finished by hand and arranged to arrive exactly as it appeared online.

items.q: Can I build my own basket?
items.a: Yes. Choose a vessel and hand-pick every item in our builder, or contact us for a fully bespoke order.
We do. Request a corporate quote for volume pricing, branded cards and multi-address delivery. We reply within one business day.

items.q: Can I cancel, return or exchange my order?
items.a: All sales are final. Every basket is perishable and packed to order for one recipient, so we cannot accept returns, exchanges or cancellations once an order is placed. If we get something wrong and a basket arrives damaged, incomplete or not as ordered, write to us within 48 hours of delivery with a photo and we will make it right.
